label: Zorya type I system
definition: A Zorya system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder Zorya_TypeI subtype locus represented by Zorya_TypeI__ZorC, Zorya_TypeI__ZorD, Zorya__ZorA, and Zorya__ZorB rule profiles.
observations: Zorya type I branch under Zorya system; distinct from the broader Zorya system, individual ZorA, ZorB, ZorC, or ZorD proteins, the individual Zorya_TypeI__ZorC, Zorya_TypeI__ZorD, Zorya__ZorA, or Zorya__ZorB HMM profile rows, unresolved phage triggers, ZorC or ZorD substrates, native host breadth outside experimentally transferred loci, and other Zorya subtypes.
